name: ImageGen豬
prompt:
Photoreal fashion catalogue photo, front view, of the lower body of the slim young adult East Asian woman in the reference image (early twenties, porcelain skin, slender legs, as in the reference). Framed from just above the waist down to the floor; both feet and shoes fully in the frame, centred, standing straight with the feet slightly apart, legs not crossed.

She wears fitted plain black stretch safety shorts (short, matte, covering the hips) and the glossy black stiletto pumps from the reference. Bare legs with natural knees and ankles, smooth even skin.

Plain soft light-grey studio background, even soft front lighting, gentle shadow on the floor, sharp detail. No skirt, no top visible beyond the waistband, no hands in the picture, no text, no watermark.
Aspect ratio 2:3, tall portrait image.
